name: outlook-graph
description: Read complete Outlook identity and thread context, update existing HTML reply drafts safely, prepare unsent drafts, and verify evidenced Inbox filing.

interface.longDescription: A separate Microsoft Graph connector for durable email references, folder and conversation reads, draft-only replies, existing HTML draft updates and verified TickTick filing. HTML updates preserve recipients and quoted history through conditional body-only writes and readback. Changes require exact expiring previews. Uses existing delegated Microsoft sign-in and encrypted local storage; no sending, deletion or runtime 1Password access. Windows and native WSL desktop support; Ubuntu packaging is provided separately. Independently developed by Rizonetech, not endorsed by Microsoft.
defaultPrompt: Read this email and confirm its permanent message ID and conversation.
Preview updating this existing HTML reply draft without sending it.
Preview filing this Inbox email with the TickTick category.
